name: Advance medical directive (AMD)
summary: How foreigners and PRs approach Singapore advance medical directives — what an AMD covers, how it differs from LPA, witnessing rules, and when to refresh after major health changes.
body:
An AMD records your refusal of extraordinary life-sustaining treatment in terminal illness under Singapore’s framework. It is not a full living will for every preference, and it is separate from lasting power of attorney (LPA) donee powers.

## Decision points
- AMD vs LPA vs will — distinct instruments
- Eligibility and witnessing requirements
- How hospitals locate and honour registered directives
- Cross-border wishes when family is overseas
- Refresh triggers after new diagnoses or moves

Pair AMD conversations with LPA planning while capacity is clear.

## How to choose
Use counsel or clinics familiar with OPG/AMD processes for foreigners and PRs. Do not assume a home-country living will substitutes locally. Tell your donee and next-of-kin where documents live.

## Practical tip
Store a copy with your LPA pack and tell your GP/clinic. An AMD nobody can find helps no one at 2 a.m.
